question: Should Twilio RCS ship as a bundled OpenClaw channel, or as an external ClawHub plugin using the existing channel Plugin SDK surface?
rationale: The repository policy defaults optional service-specific channels to plugins or ClawHub when current seams suffice, while the related open issue was filed specifically for a maintainer ruling on this exception.

options.title: Externalize to ClawHub
options.body: Move the Twilio RCS package out of the bundled distribution and publish it as a plugin with its manifest, configuration, installation docs, and redacted live smoke proof.

options.title: Sponsor bundled RCS
options.body: Accept this as a core exception, authorize the exact dependency graph, define the route-conflict upgrade behavior, and require approved-sender/device proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Externalize to ClawHub
recommendation.body: Move the Twilio RCS package out of the bundled distribution and publish it as a plugin with its manifest, configuration, installation docs, and redacted live smoke proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Introduced the closest bundled Twilio SMS channel and is best positioned to decide whether RCS should share that distribution boundary.
